title: chunk corrupts static-check.py: broken shebang, dropped exec bit, mangled comments
evidence: Patch: '-#!/usr/bin/env python3' -> '+#!/ usr / bin / env python3' and 'old mode 100755 / new mode 100644'. Verified at HEAD: `git show HEAD:scripts/static-check.py | head -1` -> '#!/ usr / bin / env python3'; `git ls-files -s scripts/static-check.py` -> '100644 0f5ee29... scripts/static-check.py'. Same hunk also mangles comments: '+# 5. CRLF scan on tracked text files(best - effort : git tracked only)' and '+#ODN - 2 / UAD - 2(r2 decision) : the SIM rate is 20 Hz'.
detail: The shebang is now invalid (spaces around tokens), so ./scripts/static-check.py no longer executes; the exec bit is lost while every sibling gate script is 100755. Comment spacing is mangled throughout. Gates still pass only because local-ci.sh calls 'python3 scripts/static-check.py'.
recommended_fix: Restore '#!/usr/bin/env python3', chmod 100755 (git update-index --chmod=+x), and re-format the mangled comment lines to normal style.

title: verify-capture-geometry.py is committed but wired to nothing — the 'geometry gate' runs nowhere
evidence: Docstring line 2: '"""scripts/verify-capture-geometry.py — the capture-pipeline geometry gate.' Grep for 'verify-capture' across scripts/ docs/ tests/ Source/ bin/ returns only self-references (lines 2 and 51). `git ls-files -s` -> '100644 96c4cda... 0 scripts/verify-capture-geometry.py' (non-executable, unlike the 100755 gate scripts).
detail: The Perkins r2 ask was a geometric check in the capture pipeline; this script implements it but no gate (local-ci.sh GATES), script, or doc invokes it. The r2 road-anchor/+0.5 regressions it detects would still ship silently.
recommended_fix: Wire it into a gate (e.g. a capture-verify step in local-ci.sh or the MCP playbook loop) with a committed fixture frame, or document it as manual in agent-playbook.md; chmod +x.

title: routing-summary loop duplicated between PPProbe and spine-check
evidence: PPProbeCommandlet.cpp: 'for (uint32_t From = 0; From < N; ++From) { for (uint32_t Dst = 0; Dst < N; ++Dst) { const uint64_t Idx = static_cast<uint64_t>(From) * N + Dst; if (Rt.HopCount[Idx] > 0) { ReachablePairs += 1; TotalHops += static_cast<int32>(Rt.HopCount[Idx]);'. spine_check.cpp lines 604-613 contain the identical From/Dst/Idx/HopCount loop computing the same two counters.
detail: Both golden writers derive reachable_pairs/total_hops with a copy-pasted traversal; a drift in one silently un-balances the 3-way compare. PP_Routing.h is engine-free, so one inline helper (e.g. RoutingSummary) could serve both surfaces.
recommended_fix: Add an inline RoutingSummary(const FRoutingTable&, uint32_t&, uint32_t&) to PP_Routing.h and call it from both PPProbeCommandlet.cpp and spine_check.cpp.

title: local-ci.sh summary lines still show the raw 'SKIPABLE:' label prefix
evidence: The SKIPABLE branch strips the prefix only for the echo/timings: 'display="$label"' / '[[ "$display" == SKIPABLE:* ]] && display="${display#SKIPABLE:}"' and 'printf ... "$display" ... >> docs/timings.md', but its result lines still use the raw label: 'results+=("⏭️   gate $i  $label  (skipped: self-skip)")', 'results+=("❌  gate $i  $label")', 'results+=("✅  gate $i  $label")'.
detail: Gate 1 renders as 'SKIPABLE:Format (clang-format --dry-run on Source/)' in the run summary and failure output, while timings.md gets the cleaned 'Format (...)' label — inconsistent presentation of the same gate.
recommended_fix: Use $display instead of $label in the three results+= lines of the SKIPABLE branch.
